scope: One-off read-only source acceptance of the current 364 published/active records; independent of HR-35
method: Fresh read-only TLS production snapshot; 349 HTTP content checks; 15 Riskified browser checks; 63 other browser checks with explicit readiness recheck for Elbit and two observed Orbit embedded forms. Only exact stored source URLs were used.
limits: No application submitted to an employer. An application control being present does not verify successful delivery.
286 passes are automated heading/content/control checks, not manual semantic review of every field or employment terms.
Only 2 Orbit forms have retained conclusive evidence. The other Orbit form batch timed out and is not counted as passed.
HTTP errors, missing job, redirects and generic error pages are not treated as confirmed closure.
No vacancy status, publication, verified_at, RLS, application code, secret, deployment or real-person record changed.
Current public UI was checked after data loading; no new mobile/iPad design acceptance is claimed by this data-only audit.
Previous 31 URL exceptions and current 51 content/source exceptions use different criteria; this is not evidence of 20 newly closed roles.
